description: Defines message classes ServerMessage and AckMessage used for communication in a distributed system.

classes.name: ServerMessage
classes.description: Represents a server message with an ID, and flags for graceful shutdown and restart.

classes.name: AckMessage
classes.description: Represents an acknowledgment message containing the original message ID and the server name.

methods.name: AckMessage.CreateAckMessage
methods.description: Static method to create an AckMessage from a ServerMessage and server name.
